notes.title: Update 1.0.1.3
notes.notes:
Update 1.0.1.3

-Fixed rare launch pad glitch.

-Fixed Astra and Scarlet story art.

-Added black border covers for ultra-wide screens.

-Prepared the games foundation for future content and updates.

-Change Red Sky to Blue for clarity. 

-Fix map glitch.

Comment if there are any issues with this update.

Thank you for playing Scarlet City of Devils!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.0 Art Update
notes.notes:
Update 1.0.1.0 
Thank you all who supported and gave feedback on Scarlet’s release.
I have updated the story art with improved shading to make it less flat.
Also, some areas color schemes have been adjusted to make Scarlet and the enemies more visible.
Sword and Axe attacks have also been adjusted to be much quicker.
Thank you for supporting Scarlet City of Devils!

Update 1.0.0.5.2

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.4.1
notes.notes:
Update 1.0.0.4.1
Rare hurt detection bug fixed. A rare event where all inputs aside from the menu button would not be responsive after taking damaged or avoiding.
Add a condition to make sure you regain control when Scarlet is idle.
Thanks to those who help point out the glitch. 
If there are any bugs please let me know.
You can use the discord button in the game to report any bugs or give feedback.

Steam Achievement reactive.

notes.title: 0.0.3.3 Update Steam Achievement Fixed
notes.notes:
Steam Achievement Fixed Finally! 

This one really kept me up all night and also the reason for the frequent updates.

Only thing left is the Chinese localization and a few addon.

Here's to a smooth release day!

notes.title: Update 0.0.3.0
notes.notes:
Updated the game so that it would remove a game breaking menu bug. Old save may not work and the Steam Achievement may not trigger.

Steam Deck compatible have been improve.

Sorry for the trouble, this menu bug kind of blindside me. However I made change so that it would not interfere with completing the game.
